config.prompt: Your step: Use ventures/cpsc-prep/LAWYER-QUESTIONS.md with counsel. Attach and confirm the trade lawyer's written opinion covering the flat monthly broker portal fee and the proposed direct batch plans. Keep all paid launches, broker contracts, and broker portal onboarding on hold until the opinion covers the exact service and fee model. Glacier will not contact a lawyer, sign a contract, create an account, collect live payment, or submit CPSC filings.

Your step: Review and approve the first broker contract. Confirm that it charges only a flat monthly fee and contains no refund commission or attorney fee split. Glacier will not sign or send the contract.
